## Checklist
- [ ] `pytest cli/tests` passes (and `python tests/invalid/build.py` if a rule changed)
- [ ] Format change? An RFC is linked and 1.x readers stay compatible
- [ ] Builder change? Strings go through `t()`; no network call at runtime
- [ ] Example or gallery character? Fully fictional, real licences, `cof validate` OK
